title: Multi-View Fair Clustering Guided by Cross-View Sensitive Information Discrepancy
abstract: arXiv:2609.25811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-view clustering (MVC) aims to uncover latent cluster structures by exploiting complementary information from multiple views. Despite substantial progress in clustering performance, fairness remains an important concern when MVC is applied to socially sensitive scenarios. Recent fair multi-view clustering methods have introduced fairness constraints into representation learning or clustering assignments. However, these methods generally treat different views under a largely uniform fairness mechanism, without explicitly distinguishing their varying levels of sensitive dependence during cross-view learning. In practice, different views may encode substantially different levels of sensitive information. Ignoring such cross-view discrepancy can allow highly sensitive-dependent views to influence less sensitive-dependent ones during cross-view learning, potentially degrading both clustering performance and fairness. translated_title: 由跨视图敏感信息差异引导的多视图公平聚类
translated_abstract: 多视图聚类（MVC）旨在通过利用多个视图的互补信息来揭示潜在的簇结构。尽管在聚类性能方面取得了显著进展，但当多视图聚类应用于社会敏感场景时，公平性仍然是一个重要问题。最近的公平多视图聚类方法已将公平性约束引入表示学习或聚类分配中。然而，这些方法通常在基本统一的公平机制下处理不同视图，没有在跨视图学习过程中显式区分各视图不同程度的敏感信息依赖性。在实践中，不同视图可能编码了差异很大的敏感信息水平。忽略这种跨视图差异可能导致高敏感依赖的视图在跨视图学习过程中影响低敏感依赖的视图，从而可能同时损害聚类性能和公平性。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由跨视图敏感信息差异引导的多视图公平聚类方法，通过显式区分各视图敏感信息依赖程度的差异，防止高敏感依赖视图在跨视图学习中污染低敏感依赖视图，从而同时提升聚类性能与公平性。
